subject: Life Skills
title: Emotional Contagion
description: A short lesson to help you apply Emotional Contagion.

hook.text: One anxious person in a meeting can infect the entire room within minutes. Nobody notices it happening.

buildup.text: Emotions spread through mirror neurons. Your brain copies the expressions and feelings of people around you.

discovery.text: A 2014 Facebook study showed that reading negative posts made people post more negatively — without any direct contact.

twist.text: The effect works in reverse. One calm, warm person can shift a tense room just by staying steady and open.

climax.text: Choose your emotional environment carefully. The moods you surround yourself with become your default over time.

punchline.text: Moods are contagious. Choose your carriers wisely.

quiz.question: How do emotions spread between people?
options: Through mirror neurons that automatically copy expressions and feelings
Only when people choose to absorb others' emotions
